newsitem.title: USA: California cheese company recalls products.
newsitem.headline: California cheese company recalls products.

text.p: California's Belfiore Cheese Co. is voluntarily recalling several of its cheese products in three states because bacteria were found in a sample, state officials said on Friday.
Listeria monocytogenes bacteria were found in a sample of its feta cheese taken during routine sampling by food inspectors, the state Department of Food and Agriculture said.
Although there have been no confirmed illnesses associated with these products, the department said several types and brands of the company's products should not be consumed.
Belfiore, based in Berkeley, has recalled various lines of Belfiore brand feta cheese, Belfiore and Edizione pennino brands of mozarella cheese and Belfiore and Edizione pennino ricotta cheese.

The products are distributed primarily in the San Francisco Bay area, Hawaii and Oregon. Stores that carry the products are removing them from the shelves and restaurants have been told to discard them immediately, the state said.
Listeria monocytogenes bacteria produce flu-like symptoms in healthy people. It is a more serious health concern for pregnant women and people with compromised immune systems, the state said.
